title: This Frog Dad Carries His Babies Inside His Throat
subject: darwin's frog

scenes.text: Some fathers carry their babies inside their throat.
A male Darwin's frog scoops up newly hatched tadpoles and tucks them into his vocal sac.
They stay inside until they've fully transformed into tiny froglets.
Then he spits out between three and seven fully formed froglets.
A deadly fungus has devastated the species in Chile. In 2024, conservationists flew 52 frogs to London Zoo.
The zoo has since reported 33 froglets, a landmark moment for the species.
